 Últimas Noticias Travel. Gather. Sparkle.
 Anterior Siguiente Experiencia del pasajero 11-19-2026 If you are traveling through CLT during the Thanksgiving season, you may notice added holiday sparkle!
 The Airport offers a festive atmosphere with the return of our iconic reindeer brothers, Wilbur and Orville, to the Atrium. CLT also added more holiday baubles and ornaments in blue, silver and gold throughout the terminal lobby, Baggage Claim and Concourses B and C. The popular new holiday décor debuted last year.
 The third annual Festival of Trees sponsored by HMSHost by Avolta, has returned to the Concourse D/E Connector, featuring 27 trees on display. Visitors can donate to various charities by scanning a QR code.
 Passenger Traffic Projections (Nov. 19 - Dec. 1) 
 This year, CLT expects almost 1.9 million passengers to arrive and depart during the 13-day holiday period from Nov. 19 - Dec. 1. That’s a 1.4% increase compared with 2025.
 More than 9,300 flights are scheduled to depart. That’s up 2.6% from last year.
 CLT expects local passenger traffic to be similar to last Thanksgiving. The Transportation Security Administration (TSA) projects more than 430,000 passengers will pass through its checkpoints, 1.5% above last year's actual count.
 The busiest travel days are expected to be Saturday, Nov. 28; Sunday, Nov. 29; and Monday, Nov. 30.
 Updated TSA Checkpoint Hours 
 From Nov. 1 – March 2027, the Transportation Security Administration will adjust its checkpoint operation hours for the winter travel season. Travelers can view updated hours and security wait times at cltairport.com or in the CLT Airport mobile app.
 Thanksgiving Hours in the Terminal 
 Lost & Found 8 a.m. – 4 p.m.
 Airport Information Desk 5 a.m. – 5 p.m.
 Charlotte Regional Visitors Authority (CRVA) 10 a.m. – 6 p.m.
 Don’t Wing It: Prepare to Fly 
 Here are some tips to help you have smooth holiday travels.
 Make sure to check out the interactive terminal map on the CLT Airport app.
 Book Parking When You Book Your Ticket 
 Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT) has plenty of parking options, nearly 25,000 spots—but more than half are online booking-only, and spots fill up quickly during peak times and holidays.
 Visit parkclt.com to guarantee your preferred parking option and secure the best rates. For convenience, download the CLT Airport app to book parking and check shuttle and security wait times.
 Guests can also sign up for the Royalty Program to earn points and rewards.
 Allow Extra Time 
 CLT suggests arriving at the terminal two hours before domestic flights and three hours before international flights. During busy travel periods, you may need to allow extra time.
 Plan to reach the parking lot thirty minutes before your desired arrival time at the terminal, as you might need to take a shuttle bus from your location.
 Updates with any significant traffic and passenger impacts will be posted in real-time to the Airport’s social media accounts (@cltairport).
 Follow @CLTairport on Facebook , X , Instagram , Threads , YouTube and LinkedIn . Download the free, all-in-one CLT Airport app at the App Store or on Google Play .
 New Airline, Routes & Flights Coming 
 Grab your calendar if you’re already planning your next getaway:
 Alaska Airlines 
 Beginning June 10, 2027, the carrier will offer daily year-round flights from CLT to SEA aboard a Boeing 737.
 American Airlines 
 Dec. 2, 2026 - nonstop service to Naples, Fla.(APF)
 March 4, 2027 - expanded seasonal service to Paris, France (CDG), beginning on March 4 to meet Spring Break demand
 May 27, 2027 - nonstop summer service from Charlotte to Barcelona, Spain (BCN)
 Charlotte travelers and those who connect through CLT will now have access to 11 daily flights to nine destinations in Europe next summer, including Barcelona (BCN), Dublin (DUB), Frankfurt (FRA), London (LHR), Madrid (MAD), Munich (MUC), Paris (CDG), Rome (FCO) and Athens (ATH), which launched in summer 2025.
 Unwind at CLT 
 CLT is upping its lounge game in the biggest way:
 American Airlines recently announced that its largest Admirals Club® Lounge will land at CLT. Construction begins this year. No opening date has been announced.
 A Capital One Lounge is already under construction on the mezzanine level of Concourse A, along with a Sidecar by The Centurion® Lounge.
 Learn more about all our lounge offerings here.
 Just Landed 
 Dirty Sodas and Craft Refreshers expand to 1897 Market (Atrium). Also available at Queen Charlotte’s Kitchen (lower level at Baggage Claim).
 Coming Soon 
 Mellow Mushroom (Concourse E) 2027
 Starbucks (D/E Connector) Dec. 15
 Visit our numerous retailers and concessionaires for some early holiday shopping ideas.
